title: Enterprise Connectivity: physical connection provisioning fee
content:
## Tier basis
Enterprise Connectivity uses the following physical connection provisioning fee for each named contract tier. New physical private connection provisioning; USD per connection.

| --- | --- | --- |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 100 Mbps | physical connection provisioning fee | 249 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 250 Mbps | physical connection provisioning fee | 249 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 500 Mbps | physical connection provisioning fee | 249 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 1 Gbps | physical connection provisioning fee | 249 |

## Basis Q&A
For the Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 100 Mbps tier, the physical connection provisioning fee is 249.
